name: Con Dao National Park
kicker: Forest and water, not one gate
summary: Cross the park for the forest and the water. The park page counts 16 islands. The Ramsar sheet counts 14. An adult scenic fee on the 2022 reprint is 60,000 VND on routes 1–3 and 50,000 VND on routes 4–17. That fee does not include the boat or the prison ticket.
timeNeeded: A day on the water or in the forest
getThere: The park office is on đường Ma Thiên Lãnh, khu 3.
heroCaption: A forest pond and the hill in the national park. The pond is not Đầm Trầu.

notice.title: The scenic fee is not the boat
notice.body: The 2022 reprint excludes ecotourism services. The boat fare and the prison ticket are separate.

body: You cross a park, not a fence with one gate. Decision 135/QĐ-TTg of 31 March 1993 founded it on the forbidden forest of Decision 85/CT of 1 March 1984. From 1 July 2025 the park says the city runs it. The park page gives 19,883.15 hectares, forest 5,883.15 and sea 14,000, plus a marine buffer of 20,500 hectares. The biodiversity agency says nearly 20,000 hectares, forest nearly 6,000, and sea nearly 14,000. Ramsar site 2203 is 19,991 hectares, designated 18 June 2013. Sixteen islands on the park page, fourteen on the Ramsar sheet. Côn Sơn is the largest on the park page. The Ramsar sheet gives Côn Sơn 5,700 hectares.

A forest pond and the hill sit inside the park. Casuarina lines a Côn Sơn shore, with a boat and a hazy ridge. Neither view is Đầm Trầu. The Vietnamese park page calls that beach’s sand yellow, fine, and flat. The English tour page says amber. Núi Thánh Giá is 577 metres and Núi Chúa is 515 metres on the park page. The biodiversity agency lists more than 1,000 vascular plants, 29 mammals, 85 birds, and 46 reptiles and amphibians, plus sóc đen Côn Sơn, about 31 hectares of mangrove, and coral reefs of about 1,000 hectares. The Ramsar sheet says 355 coral species. The species count is separate from the 1,000 hectares of reef.

The 2022 resolution reprint, in force 1 August 2022, sets the adult fee at 60,000 VND per person per route on routes 1–3 and 50,000 VND on routes 4–17, including Đầm Trầu, Ông Đụng, Bến Đầm, Cỏ Ống, and the Ma Thiên Lãnh walks. Students and trainees pay 20,000. Children and pupils pay 10,000. Those prices come from one reprint of the resolution. A 2017 service table still on the park site is extra: a night turtle guide from 350,000 to 600,000 VND by group size, hatchling release 50,000, a Vietnamese guide 300,000 for half a day and 600,000 for a day, and a snorkel set at 70,000 a turn. That table excludes the scenic fee.

figures.caption: Casuarina on a Côn Sơn shore. This is not Đầm Trầu, and the gray light is not a sand color.
figures.alt: Casuarina trees along a grassy shore with a small boat and a hazy ridge across the water

gettingThere: The park office is on đường Ma Thiên Lãnh, khu 3. The resolution does not give a street for the fee desk. Some walks on the English tour page start at the park headquarters.

Ông Đụng is about 3 km west of the town centre on that English page. The history museum’s “about 3 km” is a different leg, past the park to the unfinished bridge. The Sở Rẫy trail takes almost an hour. The return past Ma Thiên Lãnh is about 25 minutes. A boat to Hòn Bảy Cạnh is about 45 minutes. The nearly two-hour forest walk after a car or motorbike toward the airfield is not the taxi time to a beach.

legs.heading: From Côn Sơn town
legs.body: The office is on đường Ma Thiên Lãnh, khu 3. Walk minutes to the office were not printed. Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Côn Đảo airport
legs.body: VVCS is 10 km northeast of town. The Vietnamese page places Đầm Trầu northwest of Côn Sơn, near Cỏ Ống. Minutes from the terminal to the beach were not printed. Check on arrival.

hours: Day walks in daylight. Turtle nights, when booked, run 18:00–06:00.
closed: No weekly closing day was printed. Check on arrival.
admissionNote: Adult 60,000 VND per person per route on routes 1–3, and 50,000 VND on routes 4–17, from the 2022 resolution reprint in force 1 August 2022. Students 20,000. Children and pupils 10,000. The reprint says the fee does not include ecotourism services. The 2017 guide and snorkel prices are extra and exclude this fee. The prison ticket is not included. The boat fare was not printed. Check the boat on arrival.
